thread: Arsenal may be paying £60m for the wrong winger. Here's why the tape concerns me.
Everyone's watching the dribbling. Nobody's watching what happens when the ball stops moving. His Instinct is elite. His IQ isn't.
Instinct 9/10 — top 5% in transition. IQ 6/10 — bottom 40% in possession. Gravity 8/10. Transferability: 61%.
That survives a move. But not to a possession system. Arsenal's transitions work. Barcelona's structure collapses this. Would you spend £60m?

instinct.evidence: First step fires before defenders process danger.

iq.evidence: Hesitates in low blocks. Kills his own overloads.

gravity.evidence: Defenders collapse toward him before he touches it.

beats.claim: Arsenal may be paying sixty million pounds for the wrong winger.
beats.tension: Everyone's watching the dribbling. Nobody's looking at what happens when the ball stops. Nico Williams thrives in transition. He disappears when teams need him to break down a parked defence.
beats.evidence: Instinct: nine. In transition his first step fires before defenders process danger. That is top five percent. IQ: a flat six. In low blocks he hesitates, kills his own overloads, finds the wrong half-space. Gravity: eight. Defenders collapse toward him before he touches the ball, opening the weak side.
beats.reveal: Transferability: sixty-one percent. That survives a transfer. But it does not survive a possession system. Drop him into Arsenal's transitions and this works. Ask him to break down a parked defence and this collapses.
beats.loop: Would you spend sixty million knowing the system might break him?
